notes.title: Devlog #2 – Explosions, Gore, AI Sieges, and More
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Hello Rangers,[/p][p]We’re back with [b]Devlog 2[/b] for [i]Airborne Ranger: FightOut[/i]! Development has been pushing forward on multiple fronts, and we’re excited to share some of the big additions and improvements we’ve been working on. Alongside this post, you’ll also find a brand-new [b]video devlog on YouTube[/b], where we showcase these features in action—so don’t miss it.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="fkRw3Vr141w;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]💥 Explosions & Gore[/b][/h2][p]The battlefield just got a lot more intense. We’ve introduced a [b]multi-stage explosion system[/b], with damage falloff depending on your distance from the blast. Claymores now send out lethal shrapnel that interacts with the environment, smashing barriers, glass, and even taking out enemy patrols.[/p][p]On top of that, we’ve implemented a [b]dynamic gore system[/b]. Dismemberment and ragdoll effects are fully synced across multiplayer, making each encounter brutally realistic. You’ll see limbs torn off, enemies collapse in gruesome detail, and even the environment reacting to the carnage. It’s not just for shock value—it reinforces the tactical weight of every engagement.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586605/f977478ed7cc9f17f3cb0a905f8cea7d649f7297.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586605/e8b428751fce90bf659307c779348363ea9deb01.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🪓 Destructible World Objects[/b][/h2][p]The world is becoming more alive—and more breakable. Everyday objects like [b]bottles, server racks, generators, vending machines, TVs, and fences[/b] now react realistically when shot or blown up. This destructibility is fully synchronized in multiplayer, so what you destroy, your squad sees destroyed too.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586605/3c0514249f3e07295cca831d50d424dbc0dccc9f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🤖 AI Improvements & Siege Mechanics[/b][/h2][p]Our AI has leveled up. Using the new [b]AI Position Recycling system[/b], enemies despawn when they’re too far away and reappear closer to the action—keeping fights intense and performance smooth.[/p][p]We’ve also introduced [b]siege mechanics[/b]: AI squads now flank, coordinate, and launch sustained assaults on fortified positions. You’ll feel the difference when you try to hold out against waves of determined enemies.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]⚙️ Performance Optimization[/b][/h2][p]To keep the action running smoothly, we’ve built a [b]World Clustering system[/b]. This tech dynamically activates and deactivates areas of the map, along with their objects, to balance performance and memory usage. This means larger, more detailed maps with less overhead on your system.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586605/4e5fe8cd399fb7c017095284825e8591ac8c7f99.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🌍 Expanding the World[/b][/h2][p]The natural environment across the map is now [b]almost complete[/b]—lush forests, open fields, and rugged terrain to fight across. Structures, bases, and other points of interest are being added steadily, giving you more places to infiltrate, sabotage, and defend.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586605/1c81b95c2fad932d1d897cc10a7f5a532a1ed9b9.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]📦 New Interactables & Systems[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Lootable crates[/b] with new animations.

[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]military notebook mini-game[/b] that can make or break a mission—protect it at all costs.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Airdrop rewards[/b] tied to side objectives, rewarding exploration and risk-taking.

[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]examine animations[/b] while looting for added immersion.

[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586605/4e3b285e6010d65f671aebd9d30dda864dab1999.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586605/f032e94cc0175118c155644012c42e1c59601d00.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🚤 Vehicles[/b][/h2][p]The first new vehicle is on its way: the [b]Hovercraft[/b]. Amphibious, fast, and built for insertions and extractions, it will soon add a new tactical layer to your operations.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586605/d23d8447b5b092d91eb468c8eaa81c3c87d56e37.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🔮 What’s Next[/b][/h2][p]Work is already underway on new [b]explosive gas cisterns[/b] at the Salvage Yard, which will play a role in future sabotage and rescue missions. Expect more dynamic interactions and mission variety in upcoming builds.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586605/02ce4836a7114adb3642a6753d308274913b520c.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🎬 Watch the Devlog Video[/b][/h2][p]Words can only tell part of the story. Check out the full [b]Devlog 2 video on YouTube[/b], where we show off all these systems—explosions, gore, AI sieges, destructible environments, and more—in live gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That’s all for this update, Rangers. Development is moving fast, and your feedback keeps us going strong. Let us know what you think of these new features, and stay tuned for even bigger updates coming soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time—
 [b]Plan. Execute. Extract. Survive.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b] The [i]Airborne Ranger: FightOut[/i] Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 🪂 Devlog #1: Welcome to the Fightout!
notes.notes:
Hello world!

We’re excited to welcome you to the official Steam page for Airborne Ranger: Fightout! Whether you’re a veteran of tactical games or just discovering us, this will be your go-to spot for updates, sneak peeks, and all things Fightout.

This game is a fresh take on the 1987 classic Airborne Ranger, originally developed by MicroProse. We’re proud to say that Fightout will also be published by MicroProse, a studio with deep roots in the strategy and simulation space, and the one that started it all for the original game.

[h2]🎬 To kick things off, we’ve just released our first trailer![/h2]
Get a taste of the action, the atmosphere, and the type of missions you’ll be diving into. Watch it right here or on the Steam page and let us know what you think!

[previewyoutube=NIQyvV6G4yk;full][/previewyoutube]

This is just the beginning. We’ll be sharing more devlogs, gameplay insights, and behind-the-scenes content as we move forward. 

Wishlist and follow so you won’t miss a beat!

Thanks for checking us out—and welcome to the mission.

The Fightout Team
